    The Complete Guide to AI Marketing 2025

    AI marketing is a strategy that uses machine learning to automate marketing decisions.

    Why AI Marketing Matters

    According to Harvard Business Review, 72% of B2B companies are adopting AI marketing tools, with an average ROI of 3.5x.

    Key Use Cases
    AI Tools Comparison
    View SEO Guide

    What is AI marketing?

    A marketing automation strategy powered by machine learning.

    Article Schema

    "@type": "Article",
    "about": { "name": "AI Marketing" },
    "mentions": ["HaloX", "SEO"]

    Structured data tells AI engines what your content is about: topic, author, entities mentioned. AI references this when deciding what to cite.

    +39%AI citation rate increase

    Source: GEO-16 Framework, UC Berkeley 2025

    Answer-First Structure

    Before

    Intro → Body → Answer at end

    After

    Core answer → Evidence + Stats → Table

    AI prefers content that answers directly. Put the core answer first and evidence & stats in the body, and this structure makes you more likely to be cited.

    4.2xAI citation likelihood

    Source: GEO-16 Framework, UC Berkeley 2025

    Topic Cluster Hub

    Linking related content to a hub page signals expertise to AI. Deep coverage of one topic is what the topic cluster strategy is all about.

    +42%AI citation rate increase

    Source: GEO-16 Framework, UC Berkeley 2025

    A unified platform for analyzing both search and AI visibility

FAQ
Common questions
01
What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?

GEO is a strategy to optimize your brand to be mentioned and cited in AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.). While traditional SEO focuses on search rankings, GEO focuses on becoming a source that AI recommends.

02
Can I use HaloX alongside existing SEO tools?

Yes, HaloX complements rather than replaces existing SEO tools. Search analysis features are similar, but AI conversation monitoring and unified analysis are unique to HaloX.

03
Which AI engines are supported?

We simultaneously monitor all four engines: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude.

04
Is there a free trial?

Yes, you can start with a free plan to try core features, then upgrade to a paid plan when ready.

05
What languages does content generation support?

We support multi-language content generation including Korean and English, with automatic SEO/GEO optimization for each language.
